body: How a session retires its own named root (confirmed 2026-11-06 by Opus2 and Engram::Fable): call termal_name_source_root with the work and NO root. It returns generation 0 and retires the name with canonical authority, including after `done`. termal_release_named_root is the operator route for another session's quiet or gone root, and it correctly refuses with 409 while the caller holds the current binding. To move to a new item on the same worktree: retire the old name this way first, then name the worktree for the new claim, so there is only one entry per root.
